_gemini_backend_note: vertex = Google Cloud / Vertex AI (use this if your $300 credits are Google Cloud trial credits; check their expiry, typically 90 days). ai_studio = Gemini API key from AI Studio.

models.nano-banana-2: PIN_EXACT_GEMINI_MODEL_STRING_AT_BUILD (Nano Banana 2 / Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, see ai.google.dev/models)
models.nano-banana-pro: PIN_EXACT_GEMINI_MODEL_STRING_AT_BUILD (Nano Banana Pro / Gemini 3 Pro Image)
models.qa_judge: PIN_GEMINI_FLASH_CLASS_MODEL_AT_BUILD (used for QA judging AND set classification; bills to Google credits)

retries._note: max_attempts = TOTAL provider submissions per set. backoff[0,1] are in-attempt transient retries; backoff[2] is the wait between attempts.

budget._note: $12 fits the NB2 route (~$3.55/listing) with ~3x headroom. Raise before running the GPT route on a full listing.

qa._near_duplicate_note: 0-255 scale on 256px downscales; result must differ from every input frame by MORE than this. Tune after first real job.

metadata._dst_note: Default is trainedAlgorithmicMedia because the provider re-renders pixels generatively. If your MLS accepts algorithmicallyEnhanced for exposure-only blends, swap here. Verify URIs at cv.iptc.org at build time. Preserve C2PA/SynthID provenance.

delivery._branding_note: If false, deliver.py must STOP: without a watermark step the two variants are byte-identical.
